name: Nichols Day Camp
description_short: Nonprofit outdoor day camp in Sedgwick on the Blue Hill peninsula, running since 1963, with programs for ages 5 to 6, 7 to 12 and 13 to 14. The main program offers swim lessons, archery, canoeing, sailing, crafts, field games, nature and theater.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund including the $50 deposit before April 1; refund less the deposit from April 1 to May 15; after May 15 no refunds except for serious illness, and none for absences or dismissal.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Since 1963. Summer camp office 40 Camp Lane, Sedgwick 04676; off season office in Blue Hill. Programs: Scamp ages 5 and 6, Nichols ages 7 to 12, Adventure ages 13 and 14. Home page says registration for summer 2026 is open.
